About the Institution
Built for commerce education with public service at its core.
Commerce College, Kokrajhar was established on 17th March 1985 and has grown as a
                                dedicated centre for commerce education in the region. The college continues to support
                                accessible higher education, disciplined academic practice, and institutional quality
                                initiatives through IQAC, NAAC processes, student support cells, and digital services.
